propositions: A one-time history-strip operational script must be built and proven on a fresh unfiltered scratch clone before any remote publication, using only stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) with no new dependencies.

The rewrite must preserve commit count, merge-commit count, and DAG topology while removing both .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ historical copies and restoring the dynamic re-add set from git ls-tree.

The script must reject partial (blob:none) clones with a clear remedy, assert the protected remote tag is absent from the rewritten scratch clone, leave both source branch and tag unchanged, and measure the final pack below 150 MB.
The fast-export stream filter must parse data blocks by byte length rather than line filtering to correctly preserve commit messages that begin with M or D command bytes.

A completed dry-run must never push, must preserve all graph reachability assertions and tree identity after dynamic re-add, and must leave the source remote refs and tag exact and unchanged before A6-1 publication.
Post-rewrite, old-tip must not be an ancestor of new-tip, and a representative review-bot event push must complete with less than 1 MiB incremental pack growth.
